name: notion-company-renamed-to-xero-harvest-drive

deploy.description: When a Notion Companies record is renamed, push the new name to its Xero contact, Harvest client, Google Drive client folder and its [Table] Company IDs row. Source of truth: https://github.com/work-flowers/zapier-sdk/tree/main/notion-company-renamed-to-xero-harvest-drive
deploy.enable_on_publish_note: Parked at first publish so it could not double-write alongside the then-live classic Zap. Cutover done 2026-08-22; kept as the record of why v1 shipped disabled. A republish carries the CURRENT enabled state forward (read off Zapier), so this no longer affects anything.

trigger.trigger_note: Notion POLLING trigger on Companies watching the title property (Company Name), same as the classic Zap. `title` is a real choice key for that data source — verified with `list-trigger-input-field-choices`. Durable triggers have no polling-interval field, so it polls at the account default — matching the classic Zap's polling_interval_override of 0. No external URL to cut over.

notion.note: Read (never written) off the Company page: 'Company Name' (title) plus the three id properties that decide which systems get the rename — 'Xero Contact ID', 'Harvest Client ID', 'Google Drive Folder ID' (all rich_text). The page is re-fetched rather than trusted from the trigger payload, because every downstream write is a rename.

xero.action: XeroCLIAPI write `ae:515080` (Update Contact Name, custom action) with contactId / newName / xeroTenantId — the same custom action the classic Zap called. The classic pulled the tenant from a Zap component variable; it is a constant in the source here, matching the other Xero Zaps in this repo.

harvest.action: HarvestCLIAPI write `ae:541562` (Update Client Name, custom action) with clientId / newName — the same custom action the classic Zap called.

google_drive.action: GoogleDriveCLIAPI write `update_file_name` with rename_folder=true, matching the classic Zap (which also passed no `drive`; folder ids are global).

tables.01JM8PH8YM93A482M8BFZ6WKW6: [Table] Company IDs — f5 Company Name updated here, keyed on f14 Notion Page ID. Owned by notion-companies-to-zapier-table, which mirrors the same value from Notion on its own webhook; this write just makes the rename land immediately, and is free (Tables API). 'Notion Last Edited' is deliberately NOT touched, so the mirror's staleness guard still works.

replaces_classic_zap: Sync Company Name Updates to Xero, Harvest, and Zapier Table

cutover.classic_zap_disabled: 2026-08-22 — confirmed by Dennis. Not machine-verifiable: classic Zaps are exposed by neither the SDK CLI nor the MCP connector.
cutover.status: complete — this durable is the only thing propagating a Notion company rename to Xero, Harvest, Drive and the Table.

behaviour_changes: The classic Zap read the four ids out of [Table] Company IDs and halted the whole run when the company had no row there. The durable reads them off the Notion page it already has to fetch — fresher, one fewer lookup, and no dependency on the mirror having caught up. Same precedent as xero-contact-from-notion-deal and deal-to-client-drive-folder.

The four writes run as independent steps under Promise.allSettled, preserving the classic Zap's four-parallel-paths behaviour: a Xero failure no longer stops the Harvest, Drive and Table renames. Any failure still fails the run loudly, with a message naming which targets succeeded and which did not.
A blank Company Name now skips instead of propagating: renaming a Xero contact, Harvest client or Drive folder to "" is destructive, and a blank title is a real state for a freshly created row.
description: Notion Companies polling trigger (Company Name changed) -> rename that company in Xero, Harvest, Google Drive and [Table] Company IDs, each only where that system's id is recorded on the page.
